PDF Explorer by SoftCloud is a free, open-source PDF app built for your privacy. Explore, edit, and organize every document with a powerful reader, 12 built-in tools, bookmarks, favorites, and customizable themes — ad-free and offline-first.
Hide to use the app as a PDF reader only

PDF Explorer does not collect, store, transmit, or share any personal data. The app operates completely offline and does not require an internet connection. There are no analytics, tracking, or telemetry of any kind.

All bookmarks, favorites, and app preferences are stored exclusively on your device. This data never leaves your device and is not accessible to anyone except you. You have complete control and can delete this data at any time.
PDF Explorer requires storage permission to read PDF files from your device. This access is used solely to display your documents and is never used to collect or transmit any information.
If you choose to save passwords for protected PDFs, they are stored locally using encrypted storage. Passwords never leave your device.
